item.title: 'God Acts in That Soul': Priest Urges Parents to Take Kids to Mass 'Even If They Make a Fuss'
item.description: “Even if you are at Mass and completely distracted, just by being there, God is acting in your soul."

item.title: Doctors Said Abort—Now This Boy With Down Syndrome Inspires His Parish as an Altar Server
item.description: Miguel, a little boy with Down syndrome, has a tremendous love for Jesus and the courage to serve and inspire an entire Church with his "yes."

item.title: 8 Fascinating Facts You Might Not Know About St. Joseph, Foster-Father of Jesus
item.description: As Saint Teresa of Avila said, “Whatever you ask of Saint Joseph, you shall receive.”

item.title: Saints Perpetua and Felicity: The Brave Martyrdom of Two Mothers Who Chose Christ Over Death
item.description: Their story is not merely an ancient tale of persecution, but a living testament to hope, inner freedom, and unwavering fidelity to God.

item.title: Mary is the Answer to Today's Crisis: Priest Urges Catholics to Pray the Rosary Every Day
item.description: "We need Mary in a very serious way. And the best way to draw close to her is to pray the Rosary, to carry a Rosary with you."

item.title: The First Words of the Child Jesus to Saint Joseph, Revealed by a 17th-C. Mystic
item.description: What were the Child Jesus’ first words to Saint Joseph? Spanish mystic and nun Venerable Mary of Ágreda revealed the alleged answer to this question.

item.title: Know a Fallen-Away Catholic? Try This Powerful Prayer to Saint Joseph to Obtain a Conversion
item.description: As the husband of Mary, foster father of Jesus, and the patron of the Universal Church, Saint Joseph is the perfect intercessor for those hoping to obtain the conversion of a family member.

item.title: 26-Year-Old Seminarian Dies of Kidney Cancer, Leaves Powerful Spiritual Testament of Faith
item.description: “If I am called, I ask the Lord to grant me eternal rest while I await, in the communion of saints, the resurrection of the body and the life of the world to come.”

item.title: The Sacraments Hidden in 'The Legend of Zelda'? A Catholic Look at the Beloved Video Game
item.description: Beyond its gameplay, beautiful music, and epic story, 'Ocarina of Time' contains some of the most profound truths of the Catholic faith.
